about: The cut, in order. Durations are scripted seconds; a section grows when its narration take is longer (its last segment holds), and segments with a 'min' may shrink to keep the film under max_duration. Narration takes are audio/NN.* where NN is the section. Footage clips live in footage/; a missing clip previews as a placeholder card.

segments.describe: Lisa asks the house: “Ask Daniel to pick up milk on his way home”. Muse Spark reads it; the house asks “Do you want me to tell Daniel this…?” and she says yes.
Daniel’s Inbox: Lisa’s message arrived, in her words. He marks it seen.
Daniel, marked Private: “Keep this between Margaret and me: surprise party on Saturday.” Kept private: no model read it; only Daniel and Margaret can see it. Every step.
Daniel says “I’ll get Mia at 3”; the Claims page shows it open beside “home by three”, kept at 2:55 PM.

inserts.describe: The models page: each model’s one job.
Briefing: the double-booked soccer run, and Muse Wonder’s review with the entries it relied on.
SAM 3.1 outlines and counts the pantry shelf.
Daniel’s Inbox: Muse Image’s picture card for Lisa’s milk request, to take in at a glance.
